text:
Maya P.: Found a keyboard trap in batch export modal — tab focus doesn't escape the column chooser after you open 'Columns'. Liam C.: repro'd on mac/chrome. shift+tab moves to an invisible focus ring inside the menu. Olivia (Design): Ugh. We should make the chooser a proper dialog (role=dialog, aria-modal=true) and ensure return focus to export CTA. Maya P.: Also screen reader reads 'Close' twice when opening the columns menu. suspect duplicate aria-labels. Samir: Copy nit: export button currently says 'Export CSV' but it exports JSONL for vectors. Should be 'Export vectors (JSONL)'. Olivia (Design): Agreed — keep exact format in primary CTA. Add helper text 'Includes id, vector, metadata' in smaller copy. Liam C.: Proposed patch: add focus trap lib, set aria-hidden on background, ensure aria-describedby with modal body id. Quick snippet: ```html
...
``` Maya P.: Also the relevance table in preview: column headers are just icons (relevance/score) with no visible text. SR reads 'button' only. Need aria-label or visible label. Olivia (Design): The header icons are cute but not accessible. Let's add a visually-hidden label text and tooltip text. Samir: Export filename default is `redwood-vectors-.jsonl` — legal wants `projectname-vectors-`. Add project placeholder. Liam C.: I filed a tiny bug: https://redwood.internal/issue/3421 DevexBot: @here Deployed patch draft to staging for keyboard trap fix (deploy 0.52.3) Maya P.: quick QA ask: can someone run VoiceOver + NVDA on staging? I'll add checklist to the thread. Olivia (Design): Checklist: 1) Focus order modal open/close 2) SR reads modal title and description 3) Column chooser SR reads items + selected state 4) Export filename and format helper text 5) Table headers have accessible names. Samir: I tested NVDA on staging — modal title reads once, column items read with 'selected' state. Still one extra 'button' read on open. Liam C.: I'll follow up, suspect leftover role=button on the close icon with duplicate aria-label. Maya P.: Thanks team. Small copy tasks assigned: @Olivia will update CTA copy + helper text, @Samir will change default filename, @Liam will push a11y fixes. Back to you in ~24h. :thumbsup: Olivia (Design): Uploaded a screenshot and proposed copy in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/XYZ/export-copy-proposals
